# closing-the-loop

Skills to pay forward the effort invested in each task back into the project's permanent knowledge base, creating a compounding benefit towards future work.

## Installation

```bash
/plugin install @closing-the-loop
```

## Skills

### reflect

Capture hard-won knowledge back into project documentation at the end of an implementation effort. Distills context accumulated during a task — insights, conventions, gotchas, and architectural understanding — into the project's permanent knowledge base.

## Usage

Trigger the `reflect` skill at the end of any implementation phase, after a subagent completes execution, or whenever a significant body of work wraps up. Also triggers when you say things like "ok that's done", "ship it", "merge it", or ask to move on to the next task.
